intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce SMT re-enabling logic to prevent CPU wake-up failures during kexec preparation.
intent_record.what: Added a new static function kexec_smt_reenable that acquires the device hotplug lock and sets cpu_smt_num_threads and cpu_smt_control variables.
intent_record.how: Restores SMT configuration before CPU hotplug operations to ensure add_cpu() succeeds, preventing failures when cpu_bootable() rejects threads due to disabled SMT.

intent_record.intent_summary: Restores SMT state by invoking kexec_smt_reenable() prior to waking offline CPUs during kexec.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to kexec_smt_reenable() within the wake_offline_cpus function, positioned after variable initialization and before the CPU iteration loop.
intent_record.how: Ensures Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) is re-enabled during the kexec process before bringing offline CPUs back online, restoring hardware threading configuration that may have been disabled.
